title: Excision
summary: EXCIS'ION, noun s as z. [Latin excisio.] In surgery, a cutting out or cutting off any part of the body; extirpation; amputation. 1. The cutting off of a person from his people; extirpation; destructio

inlines.v: EXCIS'ION, noun s as z. [Latin excisio.] In surgery, a cutting out or cutting off any part of the body; extirpation; amputation. 1. The cutting off of a person from his people; extirpation; destruction. The rabbins reckon three kinds of excision
